title: An escaped star is a plain star
head: 2e847596c370060b2922f8cfef8b575c68b2be29

clause.text: a code span binds tighter than emphasis, struck-out text and a link's text, as on GitHub: ``**Pass `**kwargs` through**`` is "Pass **kwargs through" in bold, its `**kwargs` as code

scenes.caption: "Pass `**kwargs` through" in ** **: still all of it bold, **kwargs as code

clause.text: an escaped `\*`, `\_` or `\~` is a plain character, and never opens or ends emphasis, strong or struck-out text, as on GitHub: `Use *\*.kt* files` is "Use *.kt files", "*.kt" in italics

scenes.caption: "Use *\*.kt* files": "*.kt" in italics, its star kept, no backslash, no stray star
